mapper.select: SELECT sg.id, sg.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, g.spec, c.name AS categoryName, u.name AS unitName, sg.supply_price AS supplyPrice, sg.is_default AS isDefault, sg.last_supply_time AS lastSupplyTime, sg.last_supply_price AS lastSupplyPrice, g.status AS goodsStatus FROM supplier_goods sg JOIN goods g ON g.id = sg.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id WHERE sg.supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY sg.is_default DESC, g.name
